2610.04830.title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
2610.04830.paper_summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.
2610.04830.paper_summary_zh: 自我監督的微調在沒有標籤的情況下精煉了預訓練語言編碼器的嵌入空間。<lb/>然而，常用的方法計算成本高昂。<lb/>具體而言，基於對比學習的方法需要多視角數據和批次內的負樣本，而無負樣本的方法則需要輔助圖/網絡。<lb/>一個有趣的問題出現了：自我監督的微調是否可以在不依賴額外的負樣本或圖數據的情況下進行？<lb/>為了回答這個問題，我們介紹了SilK（輪廓引導的K均值），它在一個集群驗證指數上進行訓練，這是一種不使用標籤的集群質量內部度量。<lb/>SilK對語料庫進行聚類，然後將簡化的輪廓回歸到目標值。<lb/>每個文檔僅與k個聚類中心進行比較，而不與其他文檔比較，因此該方法不需要增強，不需要負樣本，且每個文檔僅需一個視角。<lb/>在BERT-base上，SilK每個時期的訓練速度比我們評估的最快基準快1.46倍，並且使用的峰值GPU內存比最精簡的基準少45.4%。<lb/>在凍結編碼器的線性探測下，SilK在三個下游任務中與最佳基準保持競爭力。
